days.title: East Coast run

days.desc: Cape York detour, Kakadu, Litchfield and Darwin before the Kimberley.

days.title: The West
days.desc: Broome, Ningaloo, Coral Coast and Perth — the best sunsets on the lap.

days.desc: Stock up, air down and tackle the coastal track past Cape Tribulation.

days.desc: Iconic creek crossings — Palm Creek, Gunshot and Nolans Brook.

days.desc: Stand at the northernmost point of the Australian mainland.

days.desc: Fish the rivers, camp remote and retrace south at your own pace.

days.desc: Air down and roll into the Kimberley's red-dirt heart.

days.desc: Alpine tracks, mountain-cattlemen history and huge views.

days.title: Wonnangatta & Blue Rag
days.desc: River-valley camps and the famous Blue Rag Range ridge run.

days.desc: Historic gold country, creek crossings and quiet camps.

days.desc: Rainforest camps, Central Station and a final beach cruise.
